definition: one entry per failed episode: the observation the fatal transition returned after 80 ctrl-free MuJoCo substeps
head: cddcf01d4c3c18e364f3156fbf0e2fdeeece60c5
stored_space: the 29-dim learner STATE. crl/train.py slices it to goal coordinates with config.goal_indices, so the bank always matches whatever goal projection V6 CRL trains with.

settled_state_extraction.convention: the AntMaze settled-failure convention (see scripts/rebuild_failure_bank_settled.py, SETTLE_N 80): at the fatal contact the actor loses control, ctrl is zeroed and physics advances N substeps inside the same env step. No observation field is written by hand.

composition.level_1_note: q_alpha = (1-alpha) q_normal + alpha q_fail is set per run by fail_neg_alpha, not here
composition.random_arm_note: uniform torque produces no task-relevant failures on this map, so the random/noisy component is the noisy-controller arm and is named for what it is

sampling: stratified without replacement; a short pool is a hard error, never a top-up, a duplicate or a reduced N_bank
deliberate_override_api: scripts/rockfall_clock_v6_teacher.py: LongTwoRockfallTeacher.fresh(route=..., deliberate_override_zone=None|1|2); normal_decisions / executed_decisions / deliberate_overrides expose the three quantities separately
collector_detour_coin: DISABLED in the candidate collector only (route forced to shortcut). The benchmark teacher and the frozen dataset keep 0.05.
privileged_selection_note: CLASS SELECTION AND VERIFICATION ONLY. The stored vectors are 29-dim learner ant states and carry no provenance; the sidecar fields decided WHICH of them are kept and proved each deliberate entry satisfies its contract. A bank built this way is a curated training artifact, not something the learner could have derived.
